paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N Israelte amelma tengteng a pan galmuanna apiak nung hun sautak a pai nung in Joshua ahong upa in, ahong tekta hi.
heading: Joshua Kikhakna Thugen
english: After many days, when Yahweh had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,

paite: Joshua in Israel tengteng, a-upate leh a-intekpente, avaihawmte leh aheutu teng uh asamsak a, akiang uah, "Ka upa in, ka tekta hi.
english: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un noute ziak a hiai nam tengteng tung a athilhihte na muta ua; TOUPA na Pathian un, amah mah in noute a ding in gal ahon dousak hi.
english: You have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is Yahweh your God who has fought for you.

paite: Ngai un, Jordan lui leh tumlam Tuipi Lian kikal a nam omlaite zou in, aisan in na tantuam ding un ka hon pia hi.
english: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na ma uah amau adelhkhe dia, na muhbatlouhna uah ahawlmang vek ding. TOUPA na Pathian un na kiang ua agensa bang in agam uh na luah ding uhi.
english: Yahweh your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as Yahweh your God spoke to you.

paite: Huaiziak in Mosi Dan laibu a gelh tengteng taklam ah hiam veilam ah hiam a na pialsan hetlouhna ding un hangsantak in zui un.
english: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;

paite: Hiai nam na lak ua omlaite toh tengkhawm kei un. Apathiante uh min gen kei unla, aminte un kichiam kei unla, a-nna uh leng sem kei unla, ama uah leng kun in a-nna uh sem kei un.
english: that you not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves to them;

paite: Himahleh tuni tan a na hih gige bang un, TOUPA na Pathian uh lenkip un.
english: but hold fast to Yahweh your God, as you have done to this day.

paite: TOUPA'N na ma uah nam thupitak leh hattakte adelhkhe khinta hi. Na ma uah tuni tan in kuamah pangzou himhim a-om kei uhi.
english: “For Yahweh has driven great and strong nations out from before you. But as for you, no man has stood before you to this day.

paite: Na lak ua mi khat in mi sangkhat adelh ding, na kiang ua agensa bang in, TOUPA na Pathian un nou a ding in gal ahon dousak ngal a.
english: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is Yahweh your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding in pilvang mahmah un.
english: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love Yahweh your God.

paite: Pilvang lou a, na lehngatsan himhim ua, hiai namte lak a khosuaksun, na lak ua omlaite ngei, na pawlmat ua, amaute toh pasal leh zi a na kineih ua, amaute na kithuahpih ua, amau leng nou ahon kithuahpih uleh zaw,
english: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un hiai namte na mitmuh un ahon delhkhiaksak nawn kei ding hi. TOUPA na Pathian un hiai gam hoihtak a hon piak a pan na manthat vek masiah uh amaute nou a ding in pial leh thang leh na pang ua ding in khetna chiang leh na mit ua ding in ling ahong hi zaw ding uh, chih teltak in thei un.
english: know for a certainty that Yahweh your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you.

paite: "Ngai un, tuni in leitung pumpi dan bang in ka paita ding hi. TOUPA na Pathian un na tungtang uh, ahoih lam, ana gensa tengteng vuaksuak khat lel leng a-om kei, chih na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng un na thei uhi. Na tung uah ahong tungvekta a, khat lel leng vuaksuak a-om kei hi.
english: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which Yahweh your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.

paite: Huaiziak in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un na kiang ua thil hoih agen tengteng na tung ua ahong tun vek tak mah bang in, TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak hiai gam hoihtak a pan ahon manthatsak vek masiah TOUPA'N thil hoihloute na tung uah atungsak ding hi.
english: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which Yahweh your God spoke to you, so Yahweh will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon thupiak thukhun na tatlek san ua, pathian dangte nna sem a, kun a na biak uleh, TOUPA hehna na tung uah a-om dia, ahon piak gam hoihtak a pan na mangthang pah ding uhi," achi hi.
english: when you disobey the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then Yahweh’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”
